feedback: Judged from earlier races and this candidate's contents only. Nothing here states how the candidate will perform. The candidate is the iteration 8 design, unchanged and re-confirmed in iteration 9: sensor span x = -0.05, -0.025, 0.0, 0.025, 0.05 with weights (-2, -1, 0, 1, 2), kd 0.6, kp 4.0, ki 0.2, base_speed 1.5, sensor_size 0.012, last_direction. All values are inside the contract limits and the sensor count matches the weights. Its record is the best raced result (323.64, up from 282.45 at span 0.04). The same score on two races shows the simulator is deterministic for this design. Sensor_size 0.016 (iteration 6, 157.9) and base_speed 1.3 (iteration 2, 86.8) both lowered the score, and span 0.06 (iteration 5) cut line losses but cut oval finishes. The untested alternatives (kd 0.55 at this span, or a span of about 0.045) could each lower the score, and this is the final iteration, so no later race can check them. Approving locks in the measured design for the unseen-track race. Oval steering_oscillation of about 0.40 is above the 0.32 caution level, but the score held across both races, so it is not a reason to revise now.
requested_changes: Race the iteration 8 design unchanged: span x = -0.05, -0.025, 0.0, 0.025, 0.05, kd 0.6, kp 4.0, ki 0.2, base_speed 1.5, sensor_size 0.012, last_direction. It has the best raced score (323.64, confirmed in iterations 8 and 9).
Do not raise kd above 0.6 or lower base_speed below 1.5. Kd 0.55 at span 0.04 scored below kd 0.6 (238 against 282), and base_speed 1.3 scored 86.8 against 170.5 at 1.5.
Record per-track line_loss_events, max_error, steering_oscillation, oval completion and completion_time, so the unseen-track result can be compared with the development tracks.
